detail.name: FAIL badge: normal small-text contrast at least 4.5
NEEDS REVIEW badge: normal small-text contrast at least 4.5

findings.observation: Native Tab then Enter on the caller-supplied javascript: room URL executes code inside the generated report and changes its heading. The benign canary performed no external request.
findings.cause: RoomHeaderAtom escapes an HTML attribute but makes every caller URL an active href. Escaping prevents markup injection; it does not prevent navigation to an executable scheme.
findings.proposal: At this sole link-rendering seam, parse an absolute URL with the native URL API. Only http: and https: become links; every other/malformed value remains escaped non-interactive text. Preserve trace bytes and all safe URL text. No fetch, redirect service, schema or capture change.

findings.observation: All absent costs display cost: $0.00, identical to recorded zero. Three known costs plus one absent cost display cost: $0.01, identical to a complete explicit-zero control.
findings.cause: CostBadgeAtom starts its sum at zero and discards presence information when skipping missing/non-finite entries.
findings.proposal: Count finite recorded cost entries once while summing. No entries: cost not recorded. All entries: preserve cost amount, including explicit zero. Partial entries: label known subtotal and coverage, for example known cost: $0.01 (3/4 steps). No price/provider policy or reward changes.

findings.observation: Long literal artifact/source/screenshot paths make the document wider than every standard viewport. At 390 px it is 2349 px; the ordinary fixture at computed text 200% is 499 px wide.
findings.cause: Unbreakable caller strings enlarge flex-item automatic minimum widths and overflow inline source/path text; the renderer has no bounded wrapping rule for those owned strings.
findings.proposal: Allow owned report text to wrap anywhere when necessary and bound artifact flex items to the available width with min-width:0/max-width:100%. Add only a measured same-owner flex wrapping correction if the existing evidence heading still fails. Preserve exact strings and all content; do not hide overflow, truncate, shrink fonts, or introduce a carousel.

findings.observation: The small white FAIL label on #f85149 measures 3.352238:1; NEEDS REVIEW on #d29922 measures 2.524063:1. Both are below 4.5:1.
findings.cause: Filled status classes pair white foreground with bright existing backgrounds.
findings.proposal: Change only foreground colors for the observed filled FAIL/failure-category and NEEDS REVIEW classes to a measured sufficiently dark existing palette color. Preserve wording, meaning, background, borders, and unverified/pass semantics. Verify actual pixels and computed composite contrast; do not claim all accessibility criteria passed.

findings.observation: An empty trace correctly says UNVERIFIED, but ARTIFACTS has no absence message while other empty sections explain their state.
findings.cause: The section helper already owns the empty note, but an always-present empty div makes the body string truthy.
findings.proposal: Pass an empty body for zero artifacts so the existing no artifacts produced message is used. No new empty-state system.

acceptedPlan: One existing renderer owns active room-link scheme safety, cost completeness, empty Artifacts handling and responsive/contrast styling. Its existing scenario test owner plus small HANDOFF/README changes are sufficient. No merge/reward/pricing/provider/schema policy change is required.
requiredAcceptance: Final after observer must exit nonzero on every required assertion failure, fatal, console/request/source/cleanup failure, retaining its raw receipt.
Exact visible URL text remains; absolute HTTP/HTTPS active, script/data/file/relative/malformed inactive, normalization variants and native non-execution.
Cost: empty/all missing, all explicit zeros, mixed known/missing including a known zero, and complete finite sums.
All seven original viewport pairs and named computed-font200/reduced states must preserve full strings and bounds; neither overflow hiding nor truncation closes the named proof.
Preserve original eleven trace/repair/regression bundles and original failures. Current HTML may change only as intended; hash each current artifact.
Use valid HTTP/HTTPS navigation controls and exact visible text; unsafe values remain inert rather than being erased from trajectory evidence.
After targeted/normal tests and typecheck, inspect actual current saved-file UI and native keyboard behavior; final implementation remains subject to fresh nonauthor review.

evidenceCaveat.interpretation: Original connect probe cannot prove historical connection refusal. Awaited own closures are separately recorded; current read-only Get-NetTCPConnection reports no listener. Retain original raw probe and qualify its interpretation.

limits: Approval is for the bounded plan, not the current unsafe renderer or a future implementation.
The unmodified baseline collector returned exit0 on completed collection despite16 product findings. Bound after-proof addendum requires nonzero on any required failure.

Synthetic accounting data and recorded workbook/reopen/model names remain fixture claims; actual generated JSON/HTML/Markdown artifacts and their rendered browser proof are real. No NodeRoom repair command was executed.
No app, npm install/test/build/typecheck, browser or provider was replayed by this judge. Root normalbaseline and worker runtime evidence remain separately attributed.

No physical-device/native-zoom, full accessibility, shared durable concurrency, model/provider execution, benchmark/training, packaging, shared CI or deployment certification. All full grades remain null.

Preserve this operator baseline locally. Any future publication must inert historical scripts and unsafe HTML fixtures and explicitly bind copies/omissions; this is not a portable publication approval.
